sourceDataProfile: WQP WQX 2.2 biological profile; the current user guide warns it does not include USGS data added after March 11, 2024. This retained candidate is historical and not a complete current national inventory.
method: Exact canonical taxon, positive finite Count/count, Final or Accepted, explicit field Population Census or Species Density context, valid original date and source identities, exact organization plus monitoring-location join to one active official Station county FIPS. This is a proposed preflight screen, not an approved adapter.
reviewQuestions: Whether final estimated counts support sampled historical occurrence while preserving value type.
Whether excluded Individual, Toxicity, Quality Control, positive density or biomass records can be interpreted safely, and which exclusions remain necessary.
Whether the official station join and activity locality/method context support exact county occurrence, including any contradictions.
How to cite the contributing agency, WQP DOI, exact query, access date and retained anonymous result-row identity without inventing a stable result ID.
interventions: The initial preflight chose total-site-count ahead of total-result-count in Result headers and stopped before creating a candidate report. The corrected profile-specific count check passes for all four CSVs. No acquisition was repeated and source bytes were unchanged.
